closed note 4788842 (near Széchenyikert, Debrecen) / Created about 1 year ago by Ian Pyle
Old railway lines through Kisallomas, replace by new lines through Tocovolgy / Resolved about 14 hours ago by 'Lex
Yes, there used to be an old Kisállomás station around here. You can see pictures of it here: https://debrecenikepeslapok.blogspot.com/2026/04/a-vasarteri-kisallomas-18841991.html It was demolished 20+ years ago though, so nothing remains. The Kisállomás was 'moved'; the new station is Tócósvölgy, as you mentioned: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/549344791 There is a blog post in which someone tries to showcase the old tracks (108 and 109) on old aerial images and identify any traces of them that are still visible on the ground: https://nevtelenutazo.blog.hu/2023/02/24/2022_11_05_a_109-es_es_108-as_regi_nyomvonala Nowadays, nothing remains that could be mapped.
